title: I'd like to disconnect my iphone device.

messages.text: I'd like to disconnect my iphone device. let's ask agents who need to use them before i do.

Asking now: iphone-runner (on the phone now, measuring the cooling curve), ts-gesture (robot finger fix), fix-scene-scope and fix-scroll-engine (your two new fix picks). The two fix owners work on the Simulator, so they shouldn't need the phone until a fix is found. I'll post here within a few minutes when the phone is released and safe to unplug.
Ok, let's note for agent do measure later then.

Not yet, give it 2-3 minutes. iphone-runner still holds the phone. It was recording how fast the phone cools down, which you asked for in T-009. I've told it to stop now, park Safari on a blank page and let go. I'll write 'safe to unplug' here as soon as it does.

Safe to unplug now. iphone-runner let go of the phone at 05:12, Safari is on a blank page, and nobody is waiting for it. ts-gesture confirmed its work doesn't need the phone either. These are noted for the next time you plug it in: the rest of the cooldown curve, the platform-switch check (scene-scope), the y≈2990 check (scroll-engine), the gesture tool's G run, and later the morph-start check.
